blocks.text: Nervous system ki structural (banawati) bimariyan nervous system ki jismani banawat mein kharabi ya nuqsan se hoti hain. Misalein brain tumour aur spinal cord ki choten hain.

Brain tumour dimagh mein cells ka ghair maamooli barhao ya dhela (mass) hai. Brain tumours benign (cancer ke baghair) ya malignant (cancer wale) ho sakte hain. Brain tumour glial cells se ya khud neurons se ban sakta hai. Wajahein: brain tumours ki asal wajah maloom nahin, lekin khatre ke asbab (risk factors) mein radiation ka saamna, khandani tareekh aur kuch jeeni tabdeeliyan (genetic mutations) shamil hain. Alamaat tumour ki jagah par munhasir hain. In mein sar dard, shadeed asabi dard, falij, dauray aur coma shamil ho sakte hain. Ilaj: aam ilaj surgery, radiation therapy aur chemotherapy hain.

blocks.prompt: Brain tumour ki alamaat mareez se mareez mukhtalif kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Alamaat tumour ki jagah par munhasir hain, kyun ke dimagh ke mukhtalif hisse mukhtalif kaam qaboo karte hain.

items: Structural bimariyan: brain tumour, spinal cord ki choten. Brain tumour: benign ya malignant, glial cells ya neurons se; khatre: radiation, khandan, mutations; ilaj surgery, radiation, chemotherapy.
